name: Gas Grenade
notes: Similar to Rogue Toxic Cloud. But it can explode too.
summary: Turns the Frag Grenade into a Gas Grenade that poisons enemies and explodes for half of the frag grenade's damage if set on fire. Has poison penetration instead of armor penetration. Deals 10% of frag's damage as poison stack every 0.5s with a 6 second cooldown.
